measurement_policy.wall_clock: wait4 helper CLOCK_MONOTONIC around one direct engine child; Python perf_counter also records taskset/helper overhead
measurement_policy.child_resource_usage: Linux wait4 rusage for one direct engine child; ru_maxrss is per-child KiB
measurement_policy.internal_timer: elapsed_ms/internal_ms emitted by the workload; absent for actual EJS source; webgl includes five samples per kernel
measurement_policy.bootstrap: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of candidate/baseline ratios; 95% percentile interval

confirmation_analysis.method: Original six and predeclared confirmation twenty pairs are retained separately and combined as 26 independent paired ratios, using the unchanged 10000-resample percentile bootstrap. A/A remains separate. No normalization, subtraction, or retrospective noise threshold.

diagnostics.note: Separate diagnostic executions with TRUST_JS_PERF_METRICS=1; excluded from all timing summaries.

rebase.note: Same five source-file hashes; full original suites were not rerun on rebase.

main_integration.scope: All tiers plus ARM64 native-hit assertions; host reentry/GC fixtures included.

validation.platform: Native ARM64 Linux. No fresh x86-64 or wasm32 execution.

regression_review.gate: Per metric/kernel median candidate/baseline >1.03 and 95% interval lower bound >1.0. No normalization or new noise thresholds.
regression_review.initial_gate: WebGL peak RSS 1.039515 [1.007596,1.085633] on six pairs; retained.
regression_review.confirmation_gate: Resolved on predeclared new20 and all26 pairs; combined peak RSS1.005949 [0.973345,1.038250]. All other metrics/kernels reviewed.
regression_review.aa: Twelve identical-byte pairs kept separate, checked both directions. WebGL system-time ratio unavailable because a baseline sample was zero.
regression_review.physical_allocation: Fresh non-reflink copies prepared once; hashes verified and filefrag recorded. Some extents remained delalloc/unknown_loc, so physical allocation identity is not claimed.

limits: Separate staged improvements are not multiplied into a measured cumulative result.
Single diagnostic compile/GC durations are not pause/latency conclusions.
Measured base63f2 and integration parent8988 differ only in optional architecture diagnostics, compiled out of the ordinary measured build.
